errors.text_span: it begins at a value of approximately 1.9e-6 at a training step of 0
errors.evidence: The plot shows the line starting near 0 at training step 0. The value of approximately 1.9e-6 is close to the peak of the curve (2.0e-6), which is reached after approximately 100 training steps, not at the beginning.

The description fails to mention the initial sharp increase in the learning rate from near zero to its peak. It only describes the decay part of the curve, which misrepresents the overall trend which includes a warm-up phase.
